discrepancy: Registry and actual selected-endpoint training receipt differ; use receipt 4.0, not registry 0.4. Historical receipt does not bind trainer source hash, so this is a frozen reconstruction, not bit-identical original training.
auxiliary_target: Exact stock task same-site 2x2 mean of clean high target with integer half-up rounding; differs from original Gaussian-area task
sampling: One patch per eight training sources per step; identical sequence in control and hinge continuation
candidates: Per initialization: step200, step400, weight interpolation step1-to200 alpha0.5, step1-to400 alpha0.5; no output-strength sweep
patch_guard: Unchanged every pooled/source-group overall/shadow/highlight/detail MSE nonincrease versus current bicubic and strict pooled improvement
full_guard: Every patch-qualified candidate on all four complete validation images; per-image RAW active/shadow/highlight/detail nonregression and strict pooled active improvement; freeze before historical final evaluation
limitations: Small reused Nikon stock training corpus, not full old camera+Nikon recipe
Validation held out from current updates only; overlap with historical pretraining not excluded
Historical final references reused, not newly blind
One seed and new explicitly chosen learning rate; old receipt omits learning rate
Old bilinear-base architecture preserved; current comparison baseline remains bicubic
No native/backend/temporal/visual promotion from patch metrics
Validation shadow failures motivate this separate follow-up; no historical final pixels select or tune the penalty
Previous patch-success/full-image-shadow failures motivate this separately frozen mask experiment; same reused validation, not blind.
continuation: Both cases start at original pretrained-case step400 with identical RNG20261105 and AdamW3e-5; both add local-shadow hinge0.02; only combined case adds global-shadow hinge0.02, same0.98 margin
training_masks: Per-training-patch reference shadow decile only; nontraining masks zero; no reference pixels or masks needed for inference
global_shadow_scope: Training sources only: full active-area reference tenth percentile and full-source bicubic MSE; crop targets use existing verified absolute positions. No reference or masks at inference.
